title: fix(components): ui:menubar draws an item's authored icon on every arm, at any depth (objectui#6326)
body:
Fixes #6326

## What changed

`ui:menubar` now draws an item's authored `icon`. `MenubarMenu.items` is typed `MenuItem[]`, and `MenuItem` declares `icon?: string` (the component docs list it too), but `packages/components/src/renderers/overlay/menubar.tsx` never read the key: `git grep -n -i icon` on that file returned 0 lines at base `a78cd378c`. Controls on the same pathspec: `label` returned 10 and `disabled` returned 2.

- The icon is resolved through `resolveIcon`, the lucide RECORD surface. This is the shape objectui#5930 ruled for `dropdown-menu` and objectui#6278 carried to `context-menu`. `LazyIcon` is not used.
- The repair covers **every arm that draws an item**: the top-level leaf, the submenu trigger, and the item inside a submenu. #5930 ruled that repairing only the leaf is "a narrower version of the same bug".
- The item walk is now a **local recursion** (`renderMenubarItems`, in this file only). The old renderer walked exactly one level. A submenu child that had its own `children` was drawn as a plain leaf, so those children were never shown, even though `MenuItem.children` is recursive by type and the docs describe it as "drawn as a nested submenu". The card's triage said this incidental rides the fix if the answer is "honour".
- `content/docs/components/overlay/menubar.mdx` gains an `## Icons` section, with the same wording as the context-menu page.
- Adds one patch changeset, `.changeset/6326-menubar-item-icon.md`, for `@object-ui/components`.

⛔ Not touched: `dropdown-menu.tsx` and `context-menu.tsx`. objectui#6278's ruling forbids generalising across containers, and objectui#6327 (consolidating the three recursions) is on hold. No published type or accepted shape changed (Clause-② no).

## Premise checks (at base `a78cd378c`)

- **Is there a removal ruling on menubar's `icon`?** No. #7077's ruling (comment 5534409692) covers `button-group` only: "`icon` disposition on this component = delete". It names `menubar` only as a sibling in the `disabled` / `onClick` wiring convention. #5931's last comment points the `button-group` icon third at #7077. #6327 has zero comments. #6278's ruling is scoped to `context-menu`.
- **Nested `disabled`?** The card's note said the nested-child arm drops `disabled`. That is no longer true: the objectui#6346 rider already forwards `disabled={child.disabled}`. The one-level-deep half was true, and this PR repairs it.

## Evidence

New suite `packages/components/src/__tests__/menubar-item-icon.test.tsx` has 10 rows, with lucide not mocked. Glyphs are asserted by the identity lucide gives them, `svg.lucide-NAME`, derived from the authored name. The submenu trigger's always-present chevron is asserted as a positive control on the instrument. A retired spelling (`edit`) must draw no glyph.

- **RED before the fix**, with the test on the unfixed renderer: `Tests 5 failed | 5 passed (10)`. The five failures are the leaf, submenu-trigger, submenu-child, depth-2 trigger and grandchild rows. The harness, retired-spelling and chevron-control rows stayed green.
- **GREEN after:** `Tests 10 passed (10)`.
- **Ablation**, on the fix commit `3dd2a7b`. Each mutation was checked on disk (marker count 1, remaining icon renders 1) and restored under `trap … EXIT INT TERM` using `git checkout HEAD --`. After each restore, the blob hash matched HEAD and `git diff HEAD` had 0 lines.
  - With the submenu-trigger render removed: 2 red, the submenu-trigger row and the depth-2 trigger row.
  - With the leaf render removed: 3 red, the top-level leaf, the submenu child and the grandchild.
  - Vitest resolves this renderer from source through a relative import, so no `dist/` is in the path.
- **Full package** `pnpm exec vitest run packages/components/` (from repo root, on `3dd2a7b`): `Test Files 287 passed (287) / Tests 2787 passed (2787)`. The merge of `origin/main` that followed touched zero files under `packages/components/`.
- **On final head `6d7e1e7`:**
  - Targeted tests: 8 files, 144 passed. These are the new suite, both sibling icon suites, both menu handler and separator suites, `component-fixture-declared-keys`, `menu-item-union` and `check-handler-key-read-sites`.
  - `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/components`: 9/9 successful. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` includes both the renderer and the new test.
  - The components `eslint .` pass: 503 files judged by `--format json`, 0 errors, both changed files present. Lint is not type-aware (no `projectService` / `project` in `eslint.config.js`), so this diff cannot change the lint verdict for any untouched file.
  - Every one of the following exited 0: `check-changeset-presence`, `-claims`, `-no-major`, `-fixed`, `-overwrite`, `vi-mock-specifiers` / `-inherit` / `-override-shape`, `test-path-roots`, `control-bytes`, `lucide-icon-record-names`, `doc-fence-languages`, `doc-links`, `doc-example-ids`, `doc-component-types`, `handler-key-read-sites`, `doc-example-types`, `doc-snippet-types` (`672 of 672 block(s) judged, 0 failed`, after building its 35-task prerequisite), `new-cross-file-line-citations` and `doc-example-shared-reader`.

## Acceptance notes

- The menubar catalog fixture `application-menubar.json` still authors no `icon`. No census entry was added to `check-lucide-icon-record-names.mjs` for `menubar`: with no authored name, its `min` non-vacuity rule would fail by design. The renderer is pinned by the suite above.
- Out of fence, not fixed here: in all three menu renderers the submenu-trigger arm does not forward the declared `disabled` (`MenubarSubTrigger` / `ContextMenuSubTrigger` / `DropdownMenuSubTrigger` get no `disabled` prop). This was read from source and not probed at runtime, so it is not filed as a defect. The carrier is objectui#6327, which would touch all three copies.
